## Summary

Describe the user-visible or developer-visible change.

## Verification

List the exact commands run and their results.

## Audio boundary

- [ ] No live audio or REAPER action was needed.
- [ ] Any manual audio validation is described without overstating what it proves.
- [ ] MIDI cleanup and note-off behavior remain covered when applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] Submodules are initialized and pinned.
- [ ] New behavior has regression coverage.
- [ ] Documentation matches the implemented behavior.
- [ ] No credentials, personal paths, private projects, or unlicensed audio are included.
